mapper.select: SELECT post_id AS postId, user_id AS userId, category AS category, title AS title, content AS content, created_at AS createdAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM posts WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT post_id AS postId, user_id AS userId, category AS category, title AS title, content AS content, created_at AS createdAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM posts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category = #{category} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.user_id AS userId, p.category AS category, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM posts p JOIN friends f ON p.user_id = f.following_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
